en: A colored postcard showing a richly detailed historical mural or painting framed by vaulted arches and decorative borders. The scene depicts a large group of finely dressed people in Renaissance-style clothing gathered in an outdoor setting, with dogs, children, and nobles interacting. In the background a church or cathedral tower rises above the town. The lower border of the image is decorated with ornamental panels and a doorway, and beneath this is a German caption printed in a decorative script.
